title: Investigating rtPA interactions with brain tissue and PI3K/AKT/MTOR signaling after intracerebral hemorrhage
core_idea: Assess the safety and direct effects of recombinant tissue plasminogen activator (rtPA) on neurons when it contacts brain tissue during minimally invasive surgery for intracerebral hemorrhage, and probe the underlying molecular mechanism focusing on the PI3K/AKT/MTOR pathway using in vivo (collagenase-induced ICH) and in vitro (hemin-induced) models, transcriptome sequencing, and pathway inhibitors.
tldr: This study aims to evaluate whether rtPA directly affects neurons after intracerebral hemorrhage and to investigate PI3K/AKT/MTOR-related mechanisms using animal and cell models plus transcriptomics and pharmacologic inhibitors.
